view.name: star.v_victim_metro
view.sql:
SELECT f.*, d.year, d.month, d.weekday, d.is_weekend
FROM star.fact_victim f
JOIN star.dim_date       d  ON d.date_key = f.date_key
JOIN star.dim_department dd ON dd.dep = f.dep
WHERE dd.is_metropolitan

questions.sql:
WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT year,
           sum(killed) AS killed,
           sum(victim) AS victims
    FROM star.v_victim_metro
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT
    year,
    killed,
    killed - lag(killed) OVER w                                      AS change,
    round(100.0 * (killed - lag(killed) OVER w) / lag(killed) OVER w, 1) AS change_pct,
    round(100.0 * killed / first_value(killed) OVER w, 1)            AS index_2019,
    victims,
    round(100.0 * killed / victims, 2)                               AS lethality
FROM yearly
WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY year)
ORDER BY year

SELECT
    m.mode_label                                                     AS mode,
    count(*)                                                         AS involved,
    sum(f.victim)                                                    AS victims,
    sum(f.killed)                                                    AS killed,
    round(100.0 * count(*)      / sum(count(*))      OVER (), 1)     AS share_involved_pct,
    round(100.0 * sum(f.killed) / sum(sum(f.killed)) OVER (), 1)     AS share_killed_pct,
    round(100.0 * sum(f.killed) / nullif(sum(f.victim), 0), 2)       AS lethality
FROM star.v_victim_metro f
JOIN star.dim_mode m ON m.mode_key = f.mode_key
GROUP BY m.mode_key, m.mode_label
ORDER BY killed DESC

SELECT
    CASE WHEN in_built_up_area THEN 'En agglomération'
         ELSE 'Hors agglomération' END                               AS area,
    count(DISTINCT num_acc)                                          AS accidents,
    round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT num_acc)
                / sum(count(DISTINCT num_acc)) OVER (), 1)           AS accidents_share_pct,
    sum(killed)                                                      AS killed,
    round(100.0 * sum(killed) / sum(sum(killed)) OVER (), 1)         AS killed_share_pct,
    round(100.0 * sum(killed) / count(DISTINCT num_acc), 2)          AS killed_per_100_accidents,
    round(100.0 * sum(killed) / sum(victim), 2)                      AS lethality
FROM star.v_victim_metro
GROUP BY in_built_up_area

WITH per_dep AS (
    SELECT f.dep, d.dep_name, d.region_name,
           sum(f.victim) AS victims,
           sum(f.killed) AS killed,
           round(100.0 * sum(f.killed) / sum(f.victim), 2) AS lethality
    FROM star.v_victim_metro f
    JOIN star.dim_department d ON d.dep = f.dep
    GROUP BY f.dep, d.dep_name, d.region_name
)
SELECT *,
       victims < 1000                          AS small_sample,  -- under ~170 victims a year
       rank()   OVER (ORDER BY lethality DESC) AS rank,
       ntile(4) OVER (ORDER BY lethality DESC, dep) AS quartile,
       count(*) OVER ()                        AS departments_ranked
FROM per_dep
ORDER BY rank, dep

SELECT
    hour,
    sum(killed) FILTER (WHERE weekday = 1) AS mon,
    sum(killed) FILTER (WHERE weekday = 2) AS tue,
    sum(killed) FILTER (WHERE weekday = 3) AS wed,
    sum(killed) FILTER (WHERE weekday = 4) AS thu,
    sum(killed) FILTER (WHERE weekday = 5) AS fri,
    sum(killed) FILTER (WHERE weekday = 6) AS sat,
    sum(killed) FILTER (WHERE weekday = 7) AS sun,
    sum(killed)                            AS killed,
    sum(victim)                            AS victims,
    round(100.0 * sum(killed) / sum(victim), 2) AS lethality
FROM star.v_victim_metro
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour

SELECT
    l.light_label                                   AS light,
    sum(f.victim)                                   AS victims,
    sum(f.killed)                                   AS killed,
    round(100.0 * sum(f.killed) / nullif(sum(f.victim), 0), 2) AS lethality
FROM star.v_victim_metro f
JOIN star.dim_light l ON l.light_key = f.light_key
WHERE l.light_key <> 0                -- 8 victims with unknown lighting
GROUP BY l.light_key, l.light_label
ORDER BY l.light_key

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT year,
           sum(victim)       FILTER (WHERE vehicle_category = 50)       AS escooter_victims,
           sum(killed)       FILTER (WHERE vehicle_category = 50)       AS escooter_killed,
           sum(hospitalised) FILTER (WHERE vehicle_category = 50)       AS escooter_hospitalised,
           percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY age)
                 FILTER (WHERE vehicle_category = 50 AND victim = 1)    AS escooter_median_age,
           sum(victim)       FILTER (WHERE vehicle_category IN (1, 80)) AS bicycle_victims
    FROM star.v_victim_metro
    WHERE role <> 3
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT
    year,
    escooter_victims,
    round(100.0 * (escooter_victims - lag(escooter_victims) OVER w)
                / lag(escooter_victims) OVER w, 1)                AS victims_change_pct,
    escooter_hospitalised,
    escooter_killed,
    sum(escooter_killed) OVER w                                   AS killed_running_total,
    escooter_median_age,
    bicycle_victims,
    round(100.0 * escooter_victims / bicycle_victims, 1)          AS escooter_per_100_bicycle
FROM yearly
WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY year)
ORDER BY year

WITH car_occupants AS (
    SELECT f.killed,
           CASE WHEN 1 IN (p.secu1, p.secu2, p.secu3) THEN 'Ceinture attachée'
                WHEN p.secu1 = 0                      THEN 'Aucun équipement'
                WHEN p.secu1 = 8                      THEN 'Non déterminable'
                ELSE 'Autre ou non renseigné' END AS equipment
    FROM star.v_victim_metro f
    JOIN clean.person p ON p.person_id = f.person_id
    WHERE f.mode_key = 5          -- car
      AND f.role IN (1, 2)        -- driver or passenger
)
SELECT
    equipment,
    count(*)                                                    AS involved,
    sum(killed)                                                 AS killed,
    round(100.0 * sum(killed) / count(*), 2)                    AS killed_per_100_involved,
    round(100.0 * count(*)    / sum(count(*))    OVER (), 1)    AS share_involved_pct,
    round(100.0 * sum(killed) / sum(sum(killed)) OVER (), 1)    AS share_killed_pct
FROM car_occupants
GROUP BY equipment
ORDER BY involved DESC
